status: frozen before the new independent-reference results were computed

go_kegg.go_redundancy_summary: cluster significant GO:BP terms by Jaccard >=0.5 over query intersections; retain the lowest-FDR term per component

cell_type_primary_reference.study: Chiou et al. 2023, A single-cell multi-omic atlas spanning the adult rhesus macaque brain
cell_type_primary_reference.source: published Supplementary Tables S3 and S7
cell_type_primary_reference.marker_rule: union of class top-10 and subtype top-5 logistic-regression markers, then intersect with the 21668-gene background
cell_type_primary_reference.multiple_testing: BH across the seven prespecified families

cell_type_human_sensitivity_reference.study: Siletti et al. 2023, Transcriptomic diversity of cell types across the adult human brain
cell_type_human_sensitivity_reference.marker_rule: union of the published top-10 enriched genes across clusters assigned to each prespecified broad family, then intersect with the 21668-gene background
cell_type_human_sensitivity_reference.multiple_testing: BH across the same seven families

interpretation: pre-submission independent confirmatory analysis; annotation bias only, not cell of origin, mechanism, causality, or predictive validation
